handler.name: Colonel Arthur Thorne
handler.voice: Dry, precise, quietly affectionate; ex-Royal Engineers, lost a son at Dunkirk.

wrona.name: Tomasz Wrona
wrona.bio: Lieutenant of the 18th Pomeranian Uhlans. Escapes the fall of Poland through Romania to France and England. Quiet, dry, carries his mother's rosary and a promise to come home to Warsaw.

kit.name: Margaret 'Kit' Ashdown
kit.bio: Raised between Strasbourg and Vienna, fluent in German, French and Spanish. Section D, then SOE. Quick, wry and utterly unafraid of anyone in a peaked cap.

haugland.name: Sverre Haugland
haugland.bio: Electrician at the Norsk Hydro plant at Vemork before the war; skier, mountaineer, Kompani Linge. Says little, trusts explosives because 'they never lie'.

prys.name: Owen Prys
prys.bio: A miner's son from Merthyr Tydfil who learned to shoot after rabbits and sang in the chapel choir. Joins the Commandos after Dunkirk. Grows up fast.

ndiaye.name: Idrissa Ndiaye
ndiaye.bio: Sergent of the Tirailleurs senegalais, evacuated from Dunkirk, rallied to de Gaulle in Chad. Mechanic, driver and machine-gunner; patient, paternal, fond of proverbs.

kealoha.name: Daniel 'Danny' Kealoha
kealoha.bio: Navy diver at Pearl Harbor on 7 December 1941, later an Underwater Demolition Team frogman. Easy-going, plays the ukulele, at home in any water.

lena.name: Lena Sokolova
lena.bio: A schoolteacher from Smolensk turned scout-sniper. Patient as winter, wary of everyone, including the Poles and the British.

limei.name: Li Mei
limei.bio: A village schoolteacher's daughter from Zhejiang who has fought Japan since 1937. Knows every path, smuggles anything, laughs at danger.

bhim.name: Bhim Bahadur Gurung
bhim.bio: Havildar of the 2nd Gurkha Rifles, a Chindit. Unhurried, courteous, and the most dangerous man in any jungle.

jack.name: Jack McKenna
jack.bio: A Queensland plantation manager turned coastwatcher. Lives on tinned bully beef and nerve; his teleradio is his whole world.

rosa.name: Rosa Dizon
rosa.bio: A nursing student from Nueva Ecija who joined the guerrillas in 1942. Moves through occupied towns as a market girl; carries a bolo and a list of names.

zofia.name: Zofia Wrona
zofia.bio: Tomasz's little sister, seventeen, a Home Army liaison girl who has carried messages through the Warsaw sewers since the first week of the Uprising. Knows every junction by touch.

thorne.name: Colonel Arthur Thorne
thorne.role: Commanding officer of Special Section N until his death in the Guards Chapel V-1 strike, 18 June 1944.

vahl.name: Hauptmann Erich Vahl
vahl.role: Abwehr officer, Bremen lawyer, amateur ornithologist. Names the unit 'Nachtschwalben' in 1940; runs the radio game that destroys Kit's network in 1943; fights beside the Nightjars at Itter in 1945.
